tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List cp0x referral deals with optional venue filtering. Use this when looking for deals by venue or browsing the deal catalog; links include a cp0x referral code.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Get a cp0x deal with its description and races. Use this when a deal slug is known and its full details are needed; links include a cp0x referral code.

tools.name: get_referral_code
tools.description: Find a venue's referral code and link in the cp0x catalog. Use this when a user requests referral details for a named venue; links include a cp0x referral code.

tools.name: compare_referral_benefits
tools.description: Compare the benefit the cp0x referral gives over each venue's own referral offer, with example volumes from live cp0x races. Use this when the user wants to know what a cp0x referral code adds on a venue or across a category of venues.

tools.name: list_races
tools.description: List cp0x races with dates and prizes. Use this when finding active or completed races, optionally for one deal.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Get a cp0x race leaderboard and its column definitions. Use this when viewing standings for a known deal and race.

tools.name: check_interface_restrictions
tools.description: Read declared and observed geo-restrictions for a DeFi interface. Use this when checking a protocol's interface restrictions, optionally for a country.

tools.name: list_restricted_interfaces
tools.description: List DeFi interfaces with declared or observed restrictions in a country. Use this when identifying which interfaces the cp0x monitor reports as restricted there.

tools.name: list_x402_facilitators
tools.description: List x402 facilitators and their URLs from cp0x. Use this when looking up facilitator names and endpoints in the cp0x catalog.

tools.name: list_cp0x_x402_resources
tools.description: List cp0x x402 resources with prices and tags. Use this when finding available cp0x x402 resources or filtering them by tag.

tools.name: about_cp0x
tools.description: Who cp0x is and how much it has passed on to its users, valued at today's token prices: mission, values, sites, channels, 2025 figures and every distribution with token amounts. Use this when a user asks what cp0x is, what it gave its users, or where to find its sites and channels.

tools.name: list_cp0x_open_source
tools.description: List public open-source repositories of cp0x: permissionless DeFi interfaces and tools, from GitHub. Use this when looking for cp0x interfaces, tools or source code.
